The OPIC application " Civil Society Program for Transparency and Accountability in Kosovo 2014-2015" is in line with Swedish Strategy for Development Cooperation with Kosovo 2009-2012 (extended in 2013) is relevant and thus corresponds to the input values from the Swedish government. OPIC program for Kosovo will aim to contribute: a) To strengthen capacities of local CSO's to mobilize citizens

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Palme Center implemented Sida funded project guided with its theory of change that positive transformation of a society is a result of collective organizing through various fora. In Kosovo OPIC worked with 15 CSOs. During 2015 all partner organizations jointly reached throughout Kosovo directly 16 146 citizens, 7 108 women and 9 033 men. In comparison with results from 2014 it is an increase of 20%, when total number of reached citizens was 13 369 - 5 386 women and 7982 men.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
